item.text: {"schemaVersion":"brier_reasoning_judge_v1","summary":"Across the 8 reviewed CMS Medicaid ex parte renewal-share traces, Brier generally identified the correct state-row resolver, used official CMS/data.medicaid.gov context, anchored forecasts in state-specific recent history, and incorporated pre-submit reviewer feedback into more auditable prior/update/interval explanations. The main system weaknesses are repeated: catalog lookups sometimes expose prior point/interval values that exactly match the final forecast and create circularity risk; the strict first-print original-submission resolver repeatedly drifted into same-release-day correction exceptions before review; sparse historical samples were used without a structured representation of missing months, vintage status, and volatility method; and high-ceiling percentage targets need a more standardized bounded-interval calibration. These are fixable with prompt changes, validators, and CMS-specific source adapter fields rather than case-by-case reviewer intervention.","reviewedRunCount":8,"strengths":["Most traces correctly treated the target as a single state row rather than a national average.","The runs consistently used CMS/data.medicaid.gov as the resolution source rather than relying on secondary mirrors.","Reasoning usually named recent state-specific observations and used latest-value persistence or damped local trend as the baseline.","Pre-submit review caught several concrete issues, and final traces often recorded accepted fixes in the review disposition.","Several runs explicitly noted that 2026-12-15 is ledger-based because no future CMS placeholder was found, improving auditability of the schedule assumption.","High-share states generally recognized the 100 percent mechanical ceiling and made intervals asymmetric or capped."],"systemIssues":[{"issueId":"catalog_prior_circularity","severity":"high","area":"prompt","summary":"Several traces fetched registered catalog point estimates and intervals that exactly matched the final forecast, making the reasoning appear circular even when later text claimed independent rule.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ar","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-az","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-co","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ct","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"issueId":"sparse_history_unstructured","severity":"medium","area":"data_adapter","summary":"Runs same reviewer findings recurred across runs, especially resolver correction exceptions, catalog circularity, and sparse interval explanations, indicating they should be enforced before pre-submit Allowing corrections within a release day creates cutoff and timezone ambiguity and repeatedly required reviewer correction.","proposedChange":"Add a validator rule for targets with resolutionRule containing first print, first publication, or original (O): reject reasoning or normalized cells whose resolutionRule includes phrases such as same release day, same-day correction, corrected before release day ends, or unless CMS corrects, unless the target ledger explicitly contains that exception.","expectedImpact":"Cleaner resolver text and fewer repeated pre-submit warnings on CMS first-print targets.","risk":"Some official datasets may publish corrected files under the same timestamp; those cases would need an explicit ledger flag rather than free-text exceptions.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ar","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-az","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-co","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ct","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"priority":"now","area":"prompt","summary":"Forbid using catalog point estimates and intervals as forecast evidence.","rationale":"The forecast trace should be independently auditable. Showing prior catalog values that match the final output makes it unclear whether Brier reasoned or copied.","proposedChange":"Amend the analyst prompt: catalog or ledger lookup may verify slug, unit, dataPointId, resolver, source, and resolution date only. If pointEstimate, ciLow, or ciHigh are present in local catalog context, ignore them and do not include them in tool results or reasoning unless explicitly auditing an existing catalog forecast.","expectedImpact":"Removes circular-looking traces and improves trust in generated forecasts.","risk":"The model loses access to useful baselines from previous forecasts; if needed, expose them through a separate labeled comparison track, not the main forecast evidence track.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-al","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ar","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-az","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ct","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"priority":"now","area":"data_adapter","summary":"Add a CMS Medicaid PI history adapter that returns structured vintage-aware observations.","rationale":"The fast public-release prompt is a reasonable match for CMS series, but the repeated sparse-history caveats show the agent lacks a clean history table with month coverage and submission status.","proposedChange":"Implement an adapter output object with fields: state, reportingPeriod, value, numerator, denominator, submissionStatus, firstPrintObservedAt, sourceUrl, isMissingMonth, missingReason, and vintageType. Provide the last N monthly original/O observations plus explicit unavailable months to the analyst prompt.","expectedImpact":"Better trend and volatility estimates, fewer ambiguous statements about inspected samples, and easier audit of first-print versus preliminary values.","risk":"Requires adapter maintenance when CMS schema or datastore identifiers change.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ak","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-al","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-az","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ct","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"priority":"next","area":"pack","summary":"Create a bounded-percentage interval pack for shares near 0 or 100 percent.","rationale":"Several high-share states used judgmental 99.0 caps. Making the representation mandatory should reduce repeated warnings.","proposedChange":"Require fields in reasoning: historyWindow, observationsUsed, missingObservationPolicy, priorAnchor, updateComponents with signed pp values, volatilityStatistic, intervalExpansionFactors, boundedTargetAdjustment, and finalArithmetic.","expectedImpact":"More comparable traces across states and easier automated review of arbitrary judgmental adjustments.","risk":"Longer traces and possible boilerplate if the fast prompt overuses the structure on simple stable series.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ak","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ar","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-co","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"priority":"next","area":"validator","summary":"Detect repeated reviewer findings and promote them to automatic checks.","rationale":"Pre-submit review repeatedly caught the same classes of issues. When a warning appears in three or more recent runs for the same series family, open a validator suggestion or fail condition, starting with resolver exceptions, catalog prior references, and missing sample-size statements.","expectedImpact":"Reduces manual review churn and prevents known problems from recurring in batch runs.","risk":"Phrase-based detection can be brittle; use structured fields where available and keep the initial mode as warning-only before blocking.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ak","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ar","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-co","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-dc"]},{"priority":"later","area":"ui","summary":"Show source vintage and missing-history coverage on forecast detail pages.","rationale":"Readers need to distinguish official source evidence, local derived history, preliminary release timing links, and original-resolution rows.","proposedChange":"Add a compact evidence table on run detail pages with columns for source type, reporting period, submission status, value role, and whether it was used for target resolution, history, timing, or only target registration.","expectedImpact":"Improves auditability and makes circularity or wrong-vintage evidence easier to spot visually.","risk":"Adds UI density; keep it collapsed or grouped for long traces.","evidenceRunSlugs":["medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-az","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-ca","medicaid-ex-parte-share-aug-2026-co"]}],"promptPatchCandidates":[{"file":"agents/thesis-analyst/system.md","patchSummary":"Add: For ledger/catalog lookups, use only target identity fields such as slug, unit, dataPointId, resolution source, resolution rule, and resolution date.
